observation.description: In both pairs, the central staircase shifts slightly downward and to the left in screen space, while the ceiling light panels shift slightly upward and to the right. The perspective of the room walls and floor opening adjusts correspondingly, suggesting a subtle camera repositioning or view adjustment.
observation.uncertainty: The changes are subtle and could be due to minor camera drift, rendering artifacts, or unmeasured input. Without additional context or control data, it is unclear if this is an intentional change or a side effect of other factors.
